globalStateContracts.keyboard-focus: 3px focus.ring with 2px focus.gap; visible and not obscured.
globalStateContracts.disabled: Explain prerequisite nearby; disabled is not authorization. Use native disabled for controls; preserve explanation in reachable text.
globalStateContracts.loading: Keep action label or specific progress, aria-busy, prevent repeat; do not show success prematurely.
globalStateContracts.error: State what failed, whether work was saved, safe next step and support reference when available.
globalStateContracts.offline: Preserve local input where appropriate; no offline approval or payout success; refresh server state on reconnect.
globalStateContracts.permission-denied: Do not show another tenant’s names, totals, files or even existence.
globalStateContracts.pending: Name the pending entity and what is known; never invent a promised completion time.
globalStateContracts.failed: Name the operation; reconcile authoritative status before retry.
globalStateContracts.banned: Account enforcement state distinct from failed payment; reason category, affected actions and appeal route.
globalStateContracts.notification: Delivery state is separate from underlying business event.
